final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT d.A3, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END) as avg_amount, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date > '1996-05-09' AND t.date < '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as global_avg FROM step1 WHERE avg_amount IS NOT NULL) SELECT s1.A3, s1.avg_amount, s1.cnt, s1.avg_amount / s2.global_avg as ratio FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.global_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s1.A3
